focus: Mexico campaign and legislative bulk-source sweep
targets: National campaign coverage; Chamber and Mexico City Congress bill records; Oxfam and coalition publications
saturation: Added Nuestro Presupuesto after a Mexican report directly named the platform as joining a global protest to demand creation of a wealth tax in Mexico. Oxfam México's February 2026 report credits seven principal authors and explicitly calls for progressive taxes on large fortunes; five were already recorded and two were added. Reviewed the 2026 federal annual-net-wealth bill, whose sole sponsor was already recorded. Excluded a Mexico City Congress initiative because it taxes inheritances rather than wealth stock, despite its title.
notes_next: Prioritize primary-source report author lists and formal national coalition declarations that explicitly propose annual net-wealth taxation; avoid organization rosters that only support inheritance, property or generic progressive tax changes.
